scope_classes.account_discovery: Wildcard resource scope is expected for identity and catalog discovery.
scope_classes.account_identity_enablement: iam:GetOutboundWebIdentityFederationInfo and iam:EnableOutboundWebIdentityFederation are account-level and are exercised only for a confirmed AWS-to-Azure remote workload-identity route; AWS-to-GCP uses GCP Workload Identity Federation's AWS provider without this enablement.
scope_classes.create_before_arn: Create actions remain wildcard-scoped until the created ARN exists.
scope_classes.deployment_prefix_candidate: Lifecycle actions target twin2mc-* resources after supervised ARN validation.

accepted_gaps: The offline manifest is bounded by service/action family and region but is not a formal least-privilege proof.
AWS outbound identity federation cannot be resource-scoped; preflight must show its account-wide shared enablement before mutation and must not disable it during Twin destroy.
IAM Identity Center setup is an interactive-account prerequisite and cannot be inferred from deployment credentials.

Regional CodeBuild plus the finite source bucket are deployment-time image-packaging support. Their one-off build consumption is recorded as deployment evidence and excluded from steady-state monthly Twin ranking; ECR storage remains owned by the selected deployment graph.
Provider-side Access Analyzer and CloudTrail evidence require an explicitly approved live run.
activation_gates: all required actions pass the credential self-check
supervised no-op or deploy/destroy smoke records no missing action
